{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts undershoot current prices when prices are declining, requiring inverse lag correction",
    "When sentiment is positive, increase forecast values by sentiment score to align with sentiment-driven momentum",
    "Detect and correct mean-reversion bias where model returns to historical averages deviate from continued price movement",
    "Adjust forecasts upward when sentiment diverges from model prediction to account for sentiment-driven premium",
    "Correct early-period forecast lag by accelerating convergence to true outcomes in the first 10-day window",
    "Apply differential correction based on price level, with relative adjustments greater at lower price points",
    "Blend model forecast with sentiment signal using weight proportional to forecast-error confidence" ]}
